extension.summary: The design of Easy Channel and Easy Movie for all of Kodi
O visual do Easy Channel e do Easy Movie em todo o Kodi
extension.description: A dark skin for the living room, in the design of the Monteiro add-ons. TV, Movies and Series on the home screen open Easy Channel and Easy Movie directly. Videos, Music and Pictures, confirmations, menus, the keyboard, settings, the add-on browser, the file manager and the player controls share the same look. Live TV, profiles, favourites, games and the details of videos, music and pictures are included too. Preview version: some rarely used windows, such as the playlist and smart playlist editors, the color picker and game controllers, are not included yet.

Um skin escuro para a sala, no visual dos add-ons Monteiro. TV, Filmes e Séries na tela inicial abrem direto o Easy Channel e o Easy Movie. Vídeos, Música e Imagens, confirmações, menus, o teclado, as configurações, a tela de add-ons, o gerenciador de arquivos e os controles do player têm o mesmo visual. TV ao vivo, perfis, favoritos, jogos e os detalhes de vídeos, músicas e imagens também estão incluídos. Versão de prévia: algumas telas pouco usadas, como os editores de playlists, o seletor de cores e os controles de jogos, ainda não estão incluídas.
extension.news: 0.3.9 - The time bar of the skin no longer shows over the player of Easy Movie when a video is paused, as Easy Movie shows its own. 0.3.8 - Speed on the home screen, next to Add-ons, opens Easy Speed, or offers to install it. 0.3.7 - Music on the home screen opens Easy Music, or offers to install it. The time bar over the screen shows for videos only. 0.3.6 - Repositories in the add-on browser opens Monteiro Add-ons: the add-ons of each repository in one list, with their categories. 0.3.5 - Scroll bars are whole, with rounded ends. 0.3.4 - The home screen shows the logo without the name. 0.3.3 - Pictures on the home screen opens Easy Picture, or offers to install it. 0.3.2 - The focus is blue, with white text and icons. Context menus have one background and stay on the screen with all their options. The add-on browser opens on the installed add-ons, with a toolbar for search, updates, repositories, ZIP files and settings, and progress bars keep the same height. The settings sections are square tiles with an icon, as on the home screen, with the short names Files and About. The home screen has tiles for TV, Movies, Series, Videos and Music, a smaller row for Pictures, Files and Add-ons, and Wi-Fi, Settings and Power buttons at the top right. 0.3.1 - Files on the home screen and the file manager in the settings open Easy Files when it is installed. 0.3.0 - Live TV windows: channels, guide, recordings, timers, search and the channel list over the TV. Profiles and the login screen, favourites, the playlist, the event log, games, the details of videos, music, pictures and TV programmes, the subtitle search, the music player controls, the slider, the player information and the Info key during a video. 0.2.0 - Videos, Music and Pictures on the home screen, the file manager, adding media sources, system information, the slide show and the music visualisation. Player controls with icons, the time bar while paused, notification icons, the number keys, and selected items in lists that were not shown. 0.1.0 - Preview: home screen with TV, Movies and Series opening the Easy add-ons, dialogs, keyboard, settings, add-on browser, file browser, power menu and player bars.
